minutes.headline: Commission voted to accept the attorney's response calling a resident's open meeting law complaint untimely, amid a DPW dispute.
minutes.summary: The Cemetery Commission heard a resident's three-minute complaint, then spent most of the meeting in a dispute with the DPW director over the new cemetery rules, hedge pruning, leaf-raking hours, Ray Maker (Rainmaker) software access and bench sizes. Most items were tabled or left to better communication, and the DPW director agreed to provide a maintenance plan. The commission approved the November minutes, the town report submission, and the attorney's open meeting law response.

public_comment.topic: A resident read a prepared statement accusing the chair of harassing residents and the DPW, overstepping the charter's day-to-day authority, and of improperly reconvening the November 30 meeting; he called the commission unnecessary red tape.
Brief exchange about whether public comment was allowed on the minutes motion; none was taken.
Asked for a copy of the cemetery superintendent's job description to compare against the new rules and regulations; chair agreed to provide it.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the November 30, 2023 meeting.
Approve the commission's report for the March town report.

budget_items.what_was_said: The resident alleged the chair used perpetual care funds for studies on shrubs and grass cutting.
The DPW director presented a capital request to the capital planning committee; final ranking would be seen on the spring warrant. The chair stressed the requests are joint DPW and cemetery items.
The estimate to resurface the roads was discussed as covering north and south cemeteries; the chair noted the director's final figures would be the correct ones.
A couple wishes to donate toward a memorial wall for the Barney family, but the full money is not yet in hand.
Prisoner labor is not charged to the town; the DPW pays for food. The director keeps no hours for leaf raking and blowing.
The commission says it pays annually for the software and maintenance and upgrades.
The chair said the commission usually puts in an amount each year; the deadline is mid-March.

decisions.decision: The DPW director agreed to provide an annual maintenance plan, due by March, under the new rules.
Ray Maker access dispute tabled; the chair will meet with the town manager, and the DPW director will not change access until a discussion.
The chair agreed to provide the superintendent's job description to the requester.
The commission will write the town report again, with burial numbers added, and send it to the DPW director for light edits.
The commission will schedule a meeting before the mid-March deadline for a possible warrant article; the chair will circulate dates and consider the water district room or Zoom recording.
Hedge pruning and rules dispute left unresolved with a commitment to better communication; escalation to the town manager was noted as the next step if needed.

what_happened.line: The commission voted to accept the town attorney's proposed response to a resident's open meeting law complaint and submit it as written.
A resident's prepared statement accused the chair of overstepping and called the commission unnecessary red tape, opening a long dispute with the DPW director.
The DPW director agreed to provide an annual maintenance plan under the new cemetery rules, due by March.
Hedge pruning, leaf-raking hours and bench-size rules were left unresolved; access to the Ray Maker records software was tabled until the chair meets the town manager.
The commission voted on its town report submission, to be rewritten with burial numbers and sent to the DPW director for light edits.

why_it_matters: The cemetery rules, the maintenance plan and who controls cemetery records are still unsettled between the commission and the DPW, and these set how cemetery grounds are kept.
The commission usually puts an annual amount in a warrant article, so residents may be asked to vote on cemetery money at town meeting.
watch_next: The mid-March deadline for a possible commission warrant article, with a meeting to be scheduled before it.
The DPW director's maintenance plan, due by March, and the chair's meeting with the town manager on Ray Maker access.
